detail.longDescription: We've been writing LINUXexpert study guides since 2018, and people keep asking why we'd build our own exam prep when most of it is brain dumps or labs on rails. So I built the exam engines myself. Practice exams draw from 180-question pools, weighted by domain like the real test. Lab exams run on real VMs, built fresh for every sitting and marked after a reboot on the end state, not your keystrokes. How it all works: https:// jcoffey.dev/articles/what-make s-linuxexpert-different/ # Linux # Kubernetes # CKA # RHCSA # Certification
